description: Land Acquisition - Galahitiyagama, Pallepola D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, extents, boundaries, and claimant information. The notice follows statutory procedures for land acquisition without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any other category.
